registered_work_bounds.wall_semantics: Unchanged soft in-process deadline; not an OS kill deadline.

requirements: Review and bind one concrete observer source and exact invocation before any launch; do not use this requirement record as a gate.

Before and after the child, compare exact request/gate/interpreter, all 18 production sources, source freeze, six direct input artifacts and both implicit registry metadata inputs against their opening pins. Do not accept a replaced manifest as an unchanged source.
Gate must explicitly bind accepted independent native outcome and consumer source reviews, candidate authority/P1/packet identities, exact request and observer source, and authorize only one launch.
Preserve create-only START, actual PID/parent PID, exact argv/cwd, stdout/stderr, wait/reap/exit/signal, process wall/user/system/maxRSS, failures and output identities.
Retain partial outputs and failure costs after any refusal or timeout. Never retry automatically, replace unusable positions, change bounds, or treat an exit alone as successful audit.
Retain complete P1-CONTRACTS and per-root RESULT records when produced; semantic review of outcomes is a later data-only review.
Separate outer measured window from nested child wall time. State excluded startup/preparation/serialization work rather than silently reporting it as zero.
No native replay, trace regeneration, corpus parsing, parameter selection, alternate source or three-node branch belongs to this observer.
